Statement of Cash Flows - Restricted Cash In November 2016, the FASB issued ASU 2016-18, Statement of Cash Flows , which amends Accounting Standard Codification Topic 230. This ASU requires entities to show the changes in the total of cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash and restricted cash equivalents in the statement of cash flows. As a result, entities no longer are required to present transfers between cash and cash equivalents and restricted cash and restricted cash equivalents in the statement of cash flows.
